exposure: cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) status (untreated, treated, multiple treatments)
cohort: 45,259 singleton pregnancies of women aged 29-41 years with and without cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) from the Netherlands.
finding: A strong correlation was observed between spontaneous preterm birth and an excised cervical tissue volume of >=0.5 cc, independent of CIN severity.
